title: Six-class (negation + GLV) parallel Pollard rho on secp256k1 with a global work meter and itemised step accounting (derived from 189ebc42)

claims.statement: For the uniform full-production secp256k1 target Q=[x]P, the classical cold attack in proof.md (six-class negation+GLV parallel Pollard rho: twisted R=8192 adding walk on classes keyed by |y|, exact 4-limb truncated canonical-index rule with metered fallback, doubling escapes from detected 2-cycles and checkpoint cycles of length <= 64, distinguished classes routed to 2^16 storage nodes each natively addressable below 2^56 bytes, re-walk solving) halts on every run after at most 2^126.99 target-group-operation equivalents (one unit = one batched incomplete affine secp256k1 addition, C=1000) because a global work meter charges every action before it runs. Each node holds an open-addressing table of B = 500,373,945,961,595 buckets of 104 bytes probed at most 8 deep in one fixed linear sequence; every probe is itemised at 39 instructions and charged 0.05 units, and every report whose eight buckets are occupied without a match enters a charged per-node overflow list of 8-byte bucket addresses, one per bucket, so the list can never exceed the node's slot count. The ordinary step is charged 1.15 units (the reference addition plus a 150-instruction budget over 147 itemised instructions, with field inversion I < 2^17 from M <= 227). A report costs 40.4 units (40 for route, message, entry write and node tests, plus eight probes at 0.05); the worst-case overflow insert is 2^41.45 units, the worst-case lookup 2^42.86 units, and D_cap*(22B+20) instructions = 2^107.154 units are charged in the hard extras. It succeeds with probability at least 0.39 under the disclosed heuristic H1 (random mapping on N=(r-1)/6 classes with Brent-Pollard correction and a 5% slowdown allowance; partition, distinguished, routing and bucket bits pseudo-random), supported by toy runs at R=8192; the meter's early-halt probability is below 0.0033 by Markov, so success >= 0.3917. Peak memory < 2^72 bytes (2*D_cap slots of 104 bytes plus 8 bytes per slot of probe index arrays = 2^71.64); preprocessing <= 2^59.0 units, enforced and included; no nonuniform advice. Construction credited to submissions 189ebc42 and 1c600df4 (declared dependencies). Not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Part A: production secp256k1 checks of every identity the walk uses and of the truncated canonical-index rule; Part B: the complete per-trail algorithm on prime-order toy curves y^2=x^3+7 (T_c census, pipeline success with node routing, long-trail trap test).
